title: 8 January 1965: Live: Another Beatles Christmas Show
content:
This was the 13th night of Another Beatles Christmas Show, which ran from 24 December 1964 to 16 January 1965 at London’s Hammersmith Odeon.

There were two shows on this night, with guest performers including Freddie And The Dreamers, Sounds Incorporated, Elkie Brooks, The Yardbirds, Michael Haslam, The Mike Cotton Sound and Ray Fell. The compère was Jimmy Savile.

The Beatles appeared in two sketches, one with Freddie Garrity of Freddie And The Dreamers, and another with Jimmy Savile. They closed the shows with an 11-song set: ‘Twist And Shout’, ‘I’m A Loser’, ‘Baby’s In Black’, ‘Everybody’s Trying To Be My Baby’, ‘Can’t Buy Me Love’, ‘Honey Don’t’, ‘I Feel Fine’, ‘She’s A Woman’, ‘A Hard Day’s Night’, ‘Rock And Roll Music’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Following the night’s performances, The Beatles attended a private view of the Boat Show at London’s Earls Court Exhibition Hall. They enjoyed a late-night trip on an artificial lake in a rubber dinghy and played with radio controlled boats.

Page last updated: 13 October 2021

  • 1970: Recording, mixing: Let It Be, For You Blue – George Harrison’s final recording session with The Beatles
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day five
  • 1964: Live: The Beatles’ Christmas Show
  • 1963: Television: Roundup
